name: Floriani — Barnai
description: The Barnai are the intellectual and leadership caste of the Floriani. Smaller and physically weaker than the Feskals who serve them, the Barnai are gifted with sharp minds and a talent for organisation and scholarship. Each Barnai is attended by a number of Feskal servants equal to 1 plus their SOC DM.

traits.name: Caste (Barnai)
traits.description: Barnai are the intellectual and leadership caste of the Floriani. They direct Feskal servants and have access to a wide range of careers, but carry social obligations to the nobility of their species.

species_notes: Career restriction: Barnai may only enter Agent, Army, Citizen, Merchant, Navy, Noble, Scholar, or Scout careers.
Noble obligation: at the end of each term roll 2D — on a natural 12, the Barnai must serve one term as Noble before choosing their next career.
Feskal retinue: a Barnai is accompanied by a number of Feskal servants equal to 1 + their SOC DM (minimum 0). This is a narrative detail for the referee to apply.
source: Traveller Aliens of Charted Space Volume 1, Mongoose Publishing
